thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: high gpu memory pressure on node gpu-09 (eu-west-1). 17 OOM kills in last 12m, avg memory at 94%. Auto-retry disabled for affected pool 'dedicated-eu-west-1-1'. Incident ticket created: INC-4421

maya: saw the alert, jumping in. traffic spike? any deploys around 23:40Z?

jen-oncall: no deploys from infra, metric spike started ~23:30Z and slowly ramped. logs show repeated allocation failures in paged attentn allocator. attaching quick grep output.

jen-oncall: ```
$ tail -n 200 /var/log/redwood/runtime/gpu-09.log | grep -E "OOM|cudaError|alloc failed"
[23:31:02] runtime: paged_alloc.cpp:237 alloc failed: requested 8.0MiB but only 4.2MiB free
[23:33:44] runtime: attention_pager.cc:498 evict attempt failed, fragmentation high
[23:36:10] cuda: cuCtxSynchronize -> cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
[23:38:21] runtime: kvcache.cpp:1023 slab shrink attempted, reclaimed 0 bytes
[23:40:11] kernel: oom-killer invoked for process redwood-runtime
```

eng-runtime-jin: that slab shrink line is telling — kvcache slab metadata says free but pages are noncontiguous, evicting small ranges hits overhead and leaves tiny unusable fragments. we've seen slow 'drip' where fragmentation climbs over hours.

sre-lead: initial mitigation plan: 1) divert new traffic off gpu-09, 2) trigger conservative eviction (aggressive compaction) on remaining nodes, 3) failover heavy customers to smaller model variant, 4) if continued OOMs, restart runtime on node after graceful drain. who can run the drains?

jen-oncall: I'm on it. draining now (will cordon then migrate workloads). command: ```rictl node cordon gpu-09 && rictl node drain --timeout 600 gpu-09```

maya: pinging @cust-eng-oliver for customer-impact check — are any SLA-paying customers showing errors?

cust-eng-oliver: seeing elevated 502/504s for customer "Zephyr Analytics" on EU region, about ~30 failed requests in last 10m. CS already opened a ticket. They reported timeouts starting ~23:35Z.

jen-oncall: cordon succeeded. starting evict compaction on remaining pool nodes: ```rictl runtime compaction --pool dedicated-eu-west-1-1 --mode aggressive```

eng-runtime-jin: quick note — compaction is expensive CPU wise and can temporarily raise latency; it's ok for short windows. also enabling per-model KV limit and disabling prefix caching for the largest models can reduce memory churn: config snippet below.

eng-runtime-jin: ```yaml
models:
  - name: longform-xl
    kv_cache: max_entries: 250000
    prefix_cache: enabled: false
    quant_profile: auto-qa
```

maya: can we do an immediate traffic-shift for Zephyr to the 'longform-xl-quant' smaller profile so they get fewer OOMs?

jen-oncall: started traffic-shift: ```rictl route set-weight --service zephyr-prod eu-west-1 longform-xl-quant=1.0``` done. monitoring.

incident-bot: NOTE: automatic fallback policy triggered for route zephyr-prod -> longform-xl-quant (reason: node-level OOMs).

cust-eng-oliver: Zephyr confirms errors dropped after route change, but some requests still error with 5xx from other EU nodes — looks like partial spread.

eng-runtime-jin: checking allocator stats across pool, fragmentation ratio per-slab: 
- slab-0: 8%
- slab-1: 72%
- slab-2: 65%
We have two slabs with high fragmentation. eviction policy hasn't been reclaiming because hot prefixes are pinned. Want to temporarily lower pin threshold to allow reclaim.

jen-oncall: lowering pin threshold now: ```rictl runtime set-param --pool dedicated-eu-west-1-1 kv_pin_threshold=0.6```

jen-oncall: compaction output: reclaimed ~3.8GB over 6 nodes, fragmentation dropped ~9%. GPU memory usage on gpu-09 still high but stable at 88% after graceful restart of runtime process. performed restart: ```systemctl restart redwood-runtime```

eng-runtime-jin: after restart, OOM rate dropped to 0 for 12m, but fragmentation bump remains a risk. follow-up actions: schedule a maintenance compaction window, add an allocator metric alert for fragmentation > 60% sustained, and add a fallback policy to route heavy requests to quantized variants automatically when fragmentation triggers.

sre-lead: agreed. creating follow-up ticket for allocator hardening + telemetry: TASK-8732. also recommend an on-call runbook update with steps: cordon -> drain -> aggressive compaction -> lower kv_pin_threshold -> restart -> traffic-shift.

maya: customer impact summary for postmortem: Zephyr saw ~30 failures over 10m with partial latencies increased for others. no data loss, only 5xx/timeouts. we've communicated to CS.

cust-eng-oliver: Zephyr acknowledged and will accept the fallback for now; asking for root cause analysis and timeline.

jen-oncall: marking incident as mitigated for now. keeping node cordoned until scheduled maintenance tomorrow. will follow up with diagnostic bundle: ```tar czf /tmp/gpu-09-diagnostics.tgz /var/log/redwood /var/lib/redwood/kvstats && upload-to-s3 /tmp/gpu-09-diagnostics.tgz s3://redwood-diagnostics/inc-4421/```

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: INC-4421 mitigated -> monitoring. severity reduced to SEV3.

sre-lead: thumbs up. capture the compaction run config and add to runbook. closing on-call handoff — next oncall please watch fragmentation alerts for 24h. :thumbsup:
